plan.title: Aldosterone vs vehicle kidney DE + TF activity
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single-batch bulk RNA-seq experiment on human kidney: gene-level Salmon counts (12,000 genes x 12 samples, counts.csv) with a 12-row metadata table giving one condition label per sample, 6 aldosterone-treated vs 6 vehicle controls, unpaired. The research question has two parts, so the plan has two dependent stages plus one interpretation stage.

T1S1 does the differential expression directly on the raw counts with DESeq2 (~design ~condition, vehicle as reference). n=6 per group in a single batch is a clean two-group negative-binomial problem; no covariates exist in the metadata to model, so anything beyond ~condition would be invented. The profile explicitly flags that it is not recorded whether the Salmon gene-level counts carry a length/abundance correction, so the step must inspect whether values are integers and round non-integers rather than silently failing DESeq2's integer check — and it must report which case it found, because a length-scaled TPM matrix passed as counts changes the dispersion fit. Independent filtering plus apeglm LFC shrinkage give a ranked, shrunken effect list; the 12,000-gene matrix means multiple testing is modest and BH at 0.05 is appropriate.

T1S2 answers the second half of the question. TF activity is inferred from the DE statistics, not re-derived from raw expression: decoupler's univariate linear model (ULM) run on the per-gene Wald t-statistic (the whole shrunken/unshrunken statistic vector, not the significant subset — thresholding before ULM destroys the null) against a curated signed human TF-target regulon. The environment holds CollecTRI human (source/target/weight CSV) and DoRothEA human (confidence A-E); CollecTRI is the primary prior with DoRothEA A-C as a sensitivity check, and agreement between the two is the honest measure of robustness for a 12-sample study. Gene identifiers in the counts must be reconciled to HGNC symbols before the regulon join — the step reports the overlap fraction, and a low overlap invalidates the TF result rather than merely weakening it. A 12,000-gene matrix is a subset of the transcriptome, so regulons will be partially covered; minimum regulon size after intersection is enforced (>=5 targets) and reported.

T1S3 places the DE genes in pathway context with the human WikiPathways gene sets held in the environment, over-representation on the significant set plus a rank-based test on the full statistic vector. This step is interpretive: if the pathway resource is unavailable at run time it should report that and the run still answers the question, since T1S1 and T1S2 carry the two things actually asked. Mineralocorticoid-receptor biology (NR3C2/SGK1/SCNN1 axis) is a prior expectation to check against, not a result to assume; the plan states it as a sanity anchor only.
